info.name: SafeGuard Complete API v1.3
info.description:
Comprehensive API testing collection for SafeGuard visitor management system including settings management, image upload with worker threads, and apartment change approval system.

## What's New in v1.3:
- **Apartment Change Approval System**: Complete workflow for apartment number changes requiring admin approval
- **Enhanced Settings Management**: Updated with apartment change request handling
- **Admin Approval Endpoints**: 6 new endpoints for managing apartment change requests
- **Comprehensive Testing**: End-to-end testing scenarios for all features

## Features Covered:
- System Setup & Building Registration
- User Registration & Authentication
- Visitor Management with QR Codes
- Entry/Exit Scanning (Security Only)
- Settings Management (Role-based)
- Image Upload (Profile Pictures & Building Logos)
- Apartment Change Approval Workflow
- Frequent Visitors Management
- Visitor Ban System
- Dashboard System (Role-specific)
- Analytics & Reports

## Authentication:
All endpoints use JWT Bearer token authentication. Tokens are automatically captured and stored as environment variables for seamless testing.

**Base URL**: {{base_url}}
**Version**: 1.3
**Updated**: 2025-09-16
